about: Real public files and excerpts for IS-J1's channel-name tests, read 2026-11-18 with GET only. kind file and listing: the data plane's bytes, unchanged. kind zarr-labels: an excerpt of one Zarr group's zarr.json (each channel's label and channel_type, in row order); upstream_sha256 is the hash of the full upstream response.
